title: Rental Property Service Contracts Catch-Up Upgrade Charge Worksheet
content:
**The charge.** The catch-up charge for a tier upgrade of an annual-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract is the annual tier difference times the covered share of the term, rounded to the cent once at the end.

**Line 1 — base monthly amounts.** Each base monthly amount is the tier's monthly premium plus its additional-unit premium for each unit beyond the first, on the unit count shown on the contract.
- For the tier held after the upgrade (the tier the contract now holds), the figures are that tier's monthly premium and additional-unit premium on the product's premium rate card.
- For the tier held before the upgrade (the prior tier recorded on the contract), the base monthly amount is taken from these figures: Bridgewell Rental Appliance $42.99; Bridgewell Rental Systems $47.99; Bridgewell Rental Combo $64.99; Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo $69.99 plus $39.99 for each unit beyond the first.

**Line 2 — annual tier difference.** Twelve times the base monthly amount of the tier held after the upgrade less the base monthly amount of the tier held before it, reduced first by the tier's pay-in-full discount rate and then by the portfolio discount rate recorded on the term's annual premium charge, the two reductions multiplying.

**Line 3 — covered share of the term.** The calendar days from the day after the upgrade date through the end of the term in which the upgrade was made, divided by that term's days counted from its first day through its last day inclusive. The upgrade date is the plan change date on the contract.

**Line 4.** The catch-up charge is Line 2 times Line 3, rounded to the cent once at the end; nothing is rounded before that.

## Where each input comes from

| Input | Record |
|---|---|
| Tier now held, prior tier, unit count, plan change date | the contract |
| Term start and term end dates | the contract |
| Portfolio discount rate | the term's annual premium charge in the billing history |
| Pay-in-full discount rate, monthly and additional-unit premium of the tier now held | the product's premium rate card |

## Worked example (hypothetical contract)

One unit, upgraded from Bridgewell Rental Systems to Bridgewell Rental Combo; the term's annual premium charge records a portfolio rate of 0.05; the term runs 365 days and 146 days remain after the upgrade date.

- Line 1: $64.99 for the tier after, $47.99 for the tier before.
- Line 2: the difference is $17.00; twelve times it is $204.00; reduced by 0.10 it is $183.60; reduced by 0.05 it is $174.42.
- Line 3: 146 divided by 365 is 0.4.
- Line 4: $174.42 times 0.4 is $69.768, rounded once: **$69.77**.

A three-unit building moved from Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo to Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus has, on Line 1, $69.99 plus two times $39.99, $149.97, for the tier before.
